## TSSe (from Stephan's ATAC-seq analysis)
From Stephan: Another good plot to look at is the transcription start site enhancement. In ATAC we would know to be looking for an enhancement at the TSSe - in Cut and Run the pile up depends on the histone. 

> ENCODE: Transcription start site (TSS) enrichment values are dependent on the reference files used; cutoff values for high quality data are listed in the table below. 

For `GRCh38 Refseq TSS annotation` we are looking for >7, while 5-7 is still acceptable, for `mm10 Refseq TSS annotation` (GRCm38), 10-15 is acceptable, > 15 is ideal.

Define function to calculate TSS
```{r calculate TSS coverage with soGGi and chromVAR - define function}
calculateCoverage = function(bamfile, ref) {
  distanceToTSS = -1500:1500
  coverage_ <- regionPlot(bamFile = bamfile, 
                          testRanges = ref, style = "point", 
                          format = "bam", paired = TRUE,
                          minFragmentLength = 0, 
                          maxFragmentLength = 500, 
                          normalize = "RPM")
  
  coverage = as.vector(colSums(coverage_@assays@data@listData[[1]]))
  coverage = coverage/min(coverage)
  
  coverage = data.frame(distanceToTSS, coverage)
  
  colnames(coverage) <- c("distanceToTSS", "aggregateTSSscore")
  
  return(coverage)
}
```

Get TSSs
```{r get TSSs}
TSSs <- resize(genes(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm39.knownGene), fix = "start", 1)
seqlevelsStyle(TSSs) <- "NCBI"
TSSs
```

Load BAM files
```{r load bam files}
# List all reheadered BAM files
bam_dir <- "dedup"
bam_files_for_tss <- list.files(path = bam_dir, pattern = "\\.dedup\\.reheader\\.bam$", full.names = TRUE)

# Load BAM files and get list of sample names
bam_sample_list <- c()
bam_list <- list()
for (bam_file in bam_files_for_tss) {
  sample_name <- sub("\\.dedup\\.reheader\\.bam$", "", basename(bam_file))
  bam_sample_list <- c(bam_sample_list, sample_name)
  bam_data <- bam_file
  bam_list[[sample_name]] <- bam_data
}
```

Calculate TSS coverage and plot for each sample
```{r calculate TSS coverage and plot}
tss_plots_pdf <- "plots/tss_coverage.pdf"
pdf(file = tss_plots_pdf, width = 8, height = 6)
tss_coverage_list <- list()
for (sample in bam_list) {
  # Calculate TSS
  sample_name <- sub("dedup/(.*)\\.dedup\\.reheader\\.bam", "\\1", sample)
  TSS_coverage <- c()
  TSS_coverage_ <- calculateCoverage(sample, TSSs)
  TSS_coverage <- rbind(TSS_coverage, TSS_coverage_)
  tss_coverage_list[[sample_name]] <- TSS_coverage
  # Plot TSS
  plot <- TSS_coverage %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = distanceToTSS, y = aggregateTSSscore)) +
    geom_line() +
    ggtitle(paste(sample_name)) +
    labs(x = "distance to TSS (bp)", y = "aggregate, normalized TSS score") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position="right") + 
    theme(legend.direction='vertical')
  # Print TSS plot to PDF device
  print(plot)
}
dev.off()

# Export TSS coverage dataframes
for (sample in names(tss_coverage_list)) {
  tss_df = tss_coverage_list[[sample]]
  write.csv(tss_df, paste0("plots/tss_coverage_data/", sample, "_tss_data.csv"), row.names = F)
}
```

Get TSSe scores for each sample
```{r get TSSe scores}
tss_scores <- data.frame(
  sample = names(tss_coverage_list),
  tss_score = sapply(tss_coverage_list, function(x) max(x$aggregateTSSscore, na.rm = TRUE))
)
```


## Fragment size distribution
From Stephan: One good metric to see if tagmentation worked as expected, is to look at the fragment size distributions. Fragment size distributions are particularly useful in ATACseq where you expect a peak around 100 bp (nucleosome free region) and then oscillations with maxima 200 bp mono-nucleosome, 400 bp di-nucleosome and so on.

> ENCODE: A nucleosome free region (NFR) must be present. A mononucleosome peak must be present in the fragment length distribution. These are reads that span a single nucleosome, so they are longer than 147 bp but shorter than 147*2 bp. Good ATAC-seq datasets have reads that span nucleosomes (which allows for calling nucleosome positions in addition to open regions of chromatin).

I used samtools to get fragment size counts, using code from here: https://dbrg77.wordpress.com/2017/02/10/atac-seq-insert-size-plotting/.

Plot fragment size distributions
```{r plot fragment size distribution for PEG 1}
fragment_size_plots_pdf <- "plots/fragment_size_distributions.pdf"
pdf(file = fragment_size_plots_pdf, width = 8, height = 6)

for (sample_name in sample_list) {
  # Get fragment size counts
  frag_sizes <- read.csv(paste0("fragment_size/", sample_name, ".fragment_length_count.txt"), sep = " ", header = T)
  colnames(frag_sizes) <- c("counts", "fragment_length")
  # Plot fragment size distributions
  frag_size_plot  <- frag_sizes %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = fragment_length, y = counts))+
    geom_line() +
    ggtitle(paste(sample_name)) +
    labs(x = "Fragment length (bp)", y = "Counts", color = "") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1400, by=200), limits=c(0,1400)) +
    theme_bw()
  # Print fragment size plot to PDF device
  plot(frag_size_plot)
}

dev.off()
```

## Estimated library size from Picard MarkDuplicates
Picard MarkDuplicates identifies duplicated reads and estimates the library size with duplicate reads removed.

Import all MarkDuplicates output files and get estimated library sizes
```{r import Picard MarkDuplicates output}
dedup_output_list <- list.files(path = "dedup/metrics", pattern="\\.picard_metrics\\.txt$", full.names = T)
picard_library_sizes <- list()
for (file in dedup_output_list) {
  lines <- readLines(file)
  metrics_start <- grep("^## METRICS CLASS", lines)
  if (length(metrics_start) > 0 && length(lines) > metrics_start + 2) {
    header <- strsplit(lines[metrics_start + 1], "\t")[[1]]
    values <- strsplit(lines[metrics_start + 2], "\t")[[1]]
    estimated_library_size_index <- which(header == "ESTIMATED_LIBRARY_SIZE")
    if (length(estimated_library_size_index) > 0) {
      estimated_library_size <- values[estimated_library_size_index]
      sample <- basename(file)
      sample <- sub("\\.picard_metrics\\.txt$", "", sample)
      picard_library_sizes[[sample]] <- as.numeric(estimated_library_size)
    }
  }
}
estimated_library_sizes <- data.frame(
  sample = names(picard_library_sizes),
  estimated_library_size = unlist(picard_library_sizes)
)
rownames(estimated_library_sizes) <- NULL
```

Get percent duplication
```{r get Picard percent duplication}
picard_percent_dup <- list()
for (file in dedup_output_list) {
  lines <- readLines(file)
  metrics_start <- grep("^## METRICS CLASS", lines)
  if (length(metrics_start) > 0 && length(lines) > metrics_start + 2) {
    header <- strsplit(lines[metrics_start + 1], "\t")[[1]]
    values <- strsplit(lines[metrics_start + 2], "\t")[[1]]
    percent_duplication_index <- which(header == "PERCENT_DUPLICATION")
    if (length(percent_duplication_index) > 0) {
      percent_duplication <- values[percent_duplication_index]
      sample <- basename(file)
      sample <- sub("\\.picard_metrics\\.txt$", "", sample)
      picard_percent_dup[[sample]] <- as.numeric(percent_duplication) * 100
    }
  }
}
picard_percent_dup <- data.frame(
  sample = names(picard_percent_dup),
  percent_duplication = unlist(picard_percent_dup)
)
rownames(picard_percent_dup) <- NULL
```

## Calculating fraction of reads in peak (FRiP) scores
ENCODE: The fraction of reads in called peak regions (FRiP score) should be >0.3, though values greater than 0.2 are acceptable. For EN-TEx tissues, FRiP scores will not be enforced as QC metric. TSS enrichment remains in place as a key signal to noise measure.

Total reads and reads in peaks were calculated using samtools and bedtools as outlined at https://yiweiniu.github.io/blog/2019/03/ATAC-seq-data-analysis-from-FASTQ-to-peaks/. 

```{r calculate FRiP scores}
total_reads_files <- list.files(path="frip", pattern="*.total_reads.txt", full.names=T)
reads_in_peaks_files <- list.files(path="frip/new_cutoff", pattern="*.hmmratac_reads_in_peaks.txt", full.names=T)

total_reads <- as.numeric(unlist(lapply(total_reads_files, function(x)readLines(x))))
reads_in_peaks <- as.numeric(unlist(lapply(reads_in_peaks_files, function(x)readLines(x))))

frip_data <- data.frame(total_reads_files, total_reads, reads_in_peaks)
frip_data$FRiP <- frip_data$reads_in_peaks/frip_data$total_reads
frip_data$sample <- gsub("frip\\/(.*?)\\.total_reads\\.txt", "\\1", frip_data$total_reads_files)

# Make combined dataframe with estimated library size, percent duplication, and FRiP
merged_qc_metrics <- frip_data %>%
  left_join(tss_scores, by = "sample") %>%
  left_join(estimated_library_sizes, by = "sample") %>%
  left_join(picard_percent_dup, by = "sample") %>%
  select(sample, estimated_library_size, percent_duplication, total_reads, FRiP, tss_score)
```

## Summarize peaks
Get number of peaks per sample and other measures, based on bioinformatics core pipeline. Per bioinformatics, there should be at least 10,000 peaks per sample (less means too few reads or bad data/sample prep).

Define function to read peak files from MACS3 hmmratac (format of hmmratac output: https://macs3-project.github.io/MACS/docs/hmmratac.html)
```{r define readPeaks function}
readPeaks = function(peak_file, sample_name) {
  peaks_ <- read.table(peak_file, header = FALSE, fill = TRUE) %>% mutate(width = abs(V3-V2))
  colnames(peaks_)[1:10] <- c("chr", "start", "end", "name", "score", "strand", "unused1", "unused2", "unused3", "peakSummitPosition")
  peaks_$sample <- sample_name
  return(peaks_)
}
```

Get list of peak files
```{r load peak files}
# List all hmmratac peak files
peak_dir <- "peaks/macs2"
peak_files <- list.files(path = peak_dir, pattern = "\\.narrowPeak$", full.names = TRUE)

# Make list of peak files and sample names
peak_sample_list <- c()
peak_list <- list()
for (peak_file in peak_files) {
  sample_name <- sub("\\.MACS_accessible_regions\\.narrowPeak$", "", basename(peak_file))
  peak_sample_list <- c(peak_sample_list, sample_name)
  peak_data <- peak_file
  peak_list[[sample_name]] <- peak_data
}
```

Loop over all samples and read peak files
```{r read peaks}
macs3peaks <- c()
for (name in names(peak_list)) {
  peak_file <- peak_list[[name]]
  sample_name <- name
  peaks_ <- readPeaks(peak_file, sample_name)
  macs3peaks <- rbind(macs3peaks, peaks_)
}
macs3peaks_filtered <- macs3peaks %>%
  mutate(chr = gsub("chr", "", chr)) %>%
  filter(chr %in% c(1:23, "X", "Y"))
```

Summarize peak info for each sample
```{r summarize peaks}
peak_summary <- macs3peaks %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarize(nPeaks = n(), minPeakWidth = min(width), meanPeakWidth = mean(width), medianPeakWidth = median(width), maxPeakWidth = max(width))
```

# Differential peak analysis

Import sample sheet
```{r import sample sheet}
path_to_sample_sheet <- "blacklisted_macs2_chimera_sample_sheet.csv"
samples <- read.csv(path_to_sample_sheet, header = TRUE)
samples <- samples %>%
  dplyr::select(!(MouseNumber:Mouse))
# Remove failed samples from sample sheet
failed_samples <- c("12-Ly6CMon-TLR7-CD452", "19-Ly6CMon-WT-CD4512", "30-pMon-TLR7-CD452", "31-iHPC-TLR7-CD4512", "33-Ly6CMon-TLR7-CD4512", "37-iHPC-TLR7-CD4512", "46-pMon-TLR7-CD452", "48-iHPC-TLR7-CD452", "57-pMon-TLR7-CD452", "58-iHPC-TLR7-CD4512")
samples <- samples %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl(paste(failed_samples, collapse = "|"), SampleID))
# Subset Ly6CMon samples
ly6cmon_samples <- samples %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl("Ly6CMon", SampleID))
```

## Generate counts table for consensus peaks merged across all samples
```{r generate counts table for all samples}
#consensus_peaks <- "peaks/hmmratac/new_cutoff/blacklisted/consensus_peaks.bed"
samples_no_allele <- samples %>%
  mutate(Treatment = gsub("-CD45-1", "", Treatment)) %>%
  mutate(Factor = gsub("-CD45-1", "", Factor)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Condition)
diffBindObj <- dba(sampleSheet = samples_no_allele)
# Get consensus peakset
diffBindObj <- dba.count(diffBindObj, summits = TRUE)
#Code for using previously-generated BED of consensus peaks: diffBindObj <- dba.count(diffBindObj, peaks = consensus_peaks, summits = TRUE)
```

Filter consensus peaks to exclude peaks that are less than 50bp or over 10000bp in width and/or only occur in one sample
```{r filter consensus peaks}
# Generate consensus peakset
consensus_peakset <- dba.peakset(diffBindObj, consensus = TRUE, minOverlap = 2)
# Filter consensus peakset to exclude peaks <50bp or >10000bp
consensus_peakset_filtered <- dba.peakset(consensus_peakset, bRetrieve = TRUE) #Number of peaks before filtering: 69279
consensus_peakset_filtered <- consensus_peakset_filtered[width(consensus_peakset_filtered) >= 50 & width(consensus_peakset_filtered) <= 10000] #Number of peaks after filtering: 69222
# Make count matrix using filtered peaks
diffBindObj <- dba.count(diffBindObj, peaks = consensus_peakset_filtered, summits = TRUE)
```

```{r plot heatmap}
#pdf(file = "plots/exclude_irf5_tlr7/all_samples_mutation_PCA.pdf", width = 6, height = 6)
dba.plotPCA(diffBindObj, DBA_TREATMENT)
#dev.off()
```

Normalize all data
```{r normalize all data}
# Normalize data
diffBindObj_norm <- dba.normalize(diffBindObj, method = DBA_DESEQ2, normalize = DBA_NORM_RLE)
```

Extract count matrix and filter out peaks with <10 reads in a sample and <100 reads across all samples
```{r filter peaks}
# Get count matrix
binding_matrix <- dba.peakset(diffBindObj, bRetrieve = TRUE, DataType = DBA_DATA_FRAME)
count_matrix <- binding_matrix[, 5:ncol(binding_matrix)]
# Find peaks that meet criteria
keep_peaks <- apply(count_matrix, 1, function(row){
  any_above_10 <- any(row >= 10)
  sum_above_100 <- sum(row) >= 100
  return(any_above_10 & sum_above_100)
})
# Filter DiffBind object
filteredDiffBindObject <- dba.peakset(diffBindObj, bRetrieve = FALSE, mask = keep_peaks)
```

```{r}
# Get count matrix
peaks <- dba.peakset(diffBindObj, bRetrieve = TRUE, score = DBA_SCORE_READS)
count_matrix <- as.matrix(mcols(peaks))
# Find peaks that meet criteria
keep_peaks <- apply(count_matrix, 1, function(row){
  any_above_10 <- any(row >= 10)
  sum_above_100 <- sum(row) >= 100
  return(any_above_10 & sum_above_100)
})
# Filter peaks
filtered_peaks <- peaks[keep_peaks]
# Create new DBA object using filtered peakset
filteredDiffBindObj <- dba(sampleSheet = samples_no_allele)
filteredDiffBindObj <- dba.count(filteredDiffBindObj, peaks = filtered_peaks, summits = TRUE)
```

Subset object to only Ly6CHi monocytes and set up contrast between TLR7 vs WT, normalize
```{r set up contrast for TLR7 vs WT Ly6CHi monocytes and normalize}
# Subset count matrix to only TLR7 or B6 Ly6CHi monocytes
tlr7_b6_ly6cmon_mask <- diffBindObj$samples$Tissue == "Ly6CMon" & diffBindObj$samples$Treatment %in% c("TLR7", "B6")
tlr7_b6_ly6cmon_dba <- dba(diffBindObj, mask = tlr7_b6_ly6cmon_mask)
# Filter out peaks with score <10 RPKM
tlr7_b6_ly6cmon_filtered_dba <- dba.count(tlr7_b6_ly6cmon_dba, filter = 10, filterFun = max)
# Set up contrasts
tlr7_b6_ly6cmon_dba <- dba.contrast(tlr7_b6_ly6cmon_dba, categories = DBA_TREATMENT, block = c(DBA_REPLICATE, DBA_CONDITION), reorderMeta = list(Treatment = "B6"))
# Normalize data
tlr7_b6_ly6cmon_dba <- dba.normalize(tlr7_b6_ly6cmon_dba, method = DBA_DESEQ2, normalize = DBA_NORM_RLE)
```

## Get consensus peaks per tissue/treatment combination

Get consensus peaks per tissue/treatment
```{r get condition-specific consensus peaks}
tissue_treatment_diffBindObj <- dba(sampleSheet = samples_no_allele)
tissue_treatment_consensus_peaks <- dba.peakset(tissue_treatment_diffBindObj, consensus = c(-DBA_REPLICATE), minOverlap = 0.66)
# Convert peaks to GRanges object and filter out peaks less than 50bp or more than 10000bp
tissue_treatment_consensus_peaks_gr <- tissue_treatment_consensus_peaks$peaks
tissue_treatment_filtered_peaks <- lapply(tissue_treatment_consensus_peaks_gr, function(gr) {
  gr[width(gr) >= 50 & width(gr) <= 10000]
})
tissue_treatment_filtered_peaks_gr <- GRangesList(tissue_treatment_filtered_peaks)
tissue_treatment_consensus_peaks$peaks <- tissue_treatment_filtered_peaks_gr
tissue_treatment_consensus_dba <- dba(tissue_treatment_consensus_peaks, mask = tissue_treatment_consensus_peaks$masks$Consensus, minOverlap = 2)
tissue_treatment_consensus_dba
```

Export tissue/treatment consensus peak sets as BED files
```{r export BED files}
for (i in seq_along(tissue_treatment_consensus_dba$peaks)) {

  peakset_df <- tissue_treatment_consensus_dba$peaks[[i]]
  
  # Ensure it has at least the first 3 columns: chr, start, end
  bed_df <- peakset_df[, 1:3]

  # Write to BED file (no quotes, no row names, no column names)
  write.table(bed_df, file = file_name, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
}
```

### Perform differential binding analysis on TLR7+IRF5ko vs. TLR7+ Ly6CHI monocytes and TLR7+ vs. WT (B6) Ly6CHI monocytes

#### TLR7+IRF5ko vs. TLR7+ Ly6CHI monocytes

```{r TLR7+ TLR7+IRF5ko Ly6CHI mon consensus peaks}
# Edit sample sheet to include only TLR7+ and TLR7+IRF5ko samples and remove CD45-1 allele from treatment column
tlr7_ly6cmon_samples <- ly6cmon_samples %>%
  mutate(Treatment = gsub("-CD45-1", "", Treatment)) %>%
  mutate(Factor = gsub("-CD45-1", "", Factor)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Factor == "TLR7-IRF5ko_TLR7")
#  dplyr::filter(Treatment == "TLR7" | Treatment == "TLR7-IRF5ko")
tlr7_ly6cmon_dba <- dba(sampleSheet=tlr7_ly6cmon_samples)
# Generate consensus peakset
tlr7_ly6cmon_consensus_peakset <- dba.peakset(tlr7_ly6cmon_dba, consensus = TRUE, minOverlap = 2)
# Filter consensus peakset to exclude peaks <50bp or >10000bp
tlr7_ly6cmon_filtered_consensus_peakset <- dba.peakset(tlr7_ly6cmon_consensus_peakset, bRetrieve = TRUE) #Number of peaks before filtering: 52298
tlr7_ly6cmon_filtered_consensus_peakset <- tlr7_ly6cmon_filtered_consensus_peakset[width(tlr7_ly6cmon_filtered_consensus_peakset) >= 50 & width(tlr7_ly6cmon_filtered_consensus_peakset) <= 10000] #Number of peaks after filtering: 52263
# Make count matrix using filtered peaks
consensus_peaks_tlr7_ly6cmon_counts <- dba.count(tlr7_ly6cmon_dba, peaks = tlr7_ly6cmon_filtered_consensus_peakset, summits = TRUE)
dba.plotPCA(consensus_peaks_tlr7_ly6cmon_counts, DBA_TREATMENT)
```

Normalize dataset

Get consensus peak set and annotate peaks to promoters and gene bodies
```{r annotate peaks}
# Prepare peaks for annotation
tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist <- dba.peakset(tlr7_ly6cmon_model_norm, bRetrieve = T, DataType = DBA_DATA_FRAME)
filterChr <- c("chr1", "chr2", "chr3", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5", "chr6", "chr7", "chr8", "chr9", "chr10", "chr11", "chr12", "chr13", "chr14", "chr15", "chr16", "chr17", "chr18", "chr19", "chrX", "chrY")
tlr7_ly6cmon_peak_bed <- tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist %>%
  dplyr::filter(START >= 0, CHR %in% filterChr) %>%
  dplyr::select(CHR, START, END)
options(scipen = 999)
write.table(tlr7_ly6cmon_peak_bed, file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/great_bed_files/TLR7IRF5ko-TLR7-Ly6CMon_consensus_peaks.bed", quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE) # Export consensus peaks BED as background for GREAT
tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist$peakID <- 1:nrow(tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist)
tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g <- GRanges(seqnames = tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist$CHR, 
                           IRanges(start = tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist$START, 
                                   end = tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist$END), 
                           strand = "*", 
                           peakID = tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist$peakID)
seqlevelsStyle(tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g) <- "UCSC"
tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g <- tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g[seqnames(tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g) %in% paste0("chr", c(1:23, "X", "Y"))]
seqlevels(tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g) <- ucsc_levels
seqlevelsStyle(tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g) <- "NCBI"
seqlevels(tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g)

# Annotate closest gene bodies
tlr7_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g <- ChIPpeakAnno::annotatePeakInBatch(tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g,
                                                               AnnotationData = annoData,
                                                               output = "nearestLocation",
                                                               select = "first")
tlr7_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g <- ChIPpeakAnno::addGeneIDs(tlr7_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g, orgAnn = "org.Mm.eg.db", IDs2Add = c("symbol"))
tlr7_ly6cmon_nearestGeneBodies <- data.frame(peakID = tlr7_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g$peakID, 
                                             closestGene = tlr7_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g$symbol, 
                                             distanceToGene = tlr7_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g$distancetoFeature, 
                                             closestGeneENS = tlr7_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g$feature)

# Now, all promoters within +/- 10 000 bp (one to many)
seqlevelsStyle(tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g) <- "UCSC"
tlr7_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g <- ChIPpeakAnno::annotatePeakInBatch(tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g, 
                                                                 AnnotationData = annoData, 
                                                                 output = "nearestBiDirectionalPromoters",
                                                                 bindingRegion = c(-10000, 10000),
                                                                 select = "all")
tlr7_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g <- ChIPpeakAnno::addGeneIDs(tlr7_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g, orgAnn = "org.Mm.eg.db", IDs2Add = c("symbol"))
tlr7_ly6cmon_nearPromoters <- data.frame(peakID = tlr7_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g$peakID,
                                         distanceToPromoter = tlr7_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g$distanceToSite,
                                         promoterSymbol = tlr7_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g$gene_name,
                                         promoterENS = tlr7_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g$feature)

# All peaks that weren't annotated, we are now going to find, and then look for the one closest promoter within 100 000 bp (one to one)
tlr7_ly6cmon_missingPeakIDs <- setdiff(tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g$peakID, tlr7_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g$peakID)
tlr7_ly6cmon_missingPeaks.g <- tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g[tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g$peakID %in% tlr7_ly6cmon_missingPeakIDs]
tlr7_ly6cmon_farPromoters.g <- ChIPpeakAnno::annotatePeakInBatch(tlr7_ly6cmon_missingPeaks.g,
                                                                 AnnotationData = annoData,
                                                                 output = "nearestBiDirectionalPromoters", 
                                                                 bindingRegion = c(-100000, 100000),
                                                                 select = "all")
tlr7_ly6cmon_farPromoters <- data.frame(peakID = tlr7_ly6cmon_farPromoters.g$peakID,
                                        distanceToPromoter = tlr7_ly6cmon_farPromoters.g$distanceToSite,
                                        promoterSymbol = tlr7_ly6cmon_farPromoters.g$gene_name,
                                        promoterENS = tlr7_ly6cmon_farPromoters.g$feature)
tlr7_ly6cmon_promoters <- rbind(tlr7_ly6cmon_nearPromoters, tlr7_ly6cmon_farPromoters)
tlr7_ly6cmon_promoters <- dplyr::distinct(tlr7_ly6cmon_promoters)
```

Process contrasts
```{r process contrasts}
tlr7_ly6cmon_contrasts <- dba.show(tlr7_ly6cmon_model_norm, bContrast = TRUE)
tlr7_ly6cmon_contrasts <- dplyr::mutate(tlr7_ly6cmon_contrasts, name = paste0(Group, "_vs_", Group2))
dge_tlr7_ly6cmon <- c()
for (iContrast in 1:nrow(tlr7_ly6cmon_contrasts)) {
  dge_ <- dba.report(tlr7_ly6cmon_model_norm, method = DBA_DESEQ2, contrast = iContrast, th = 1, DataType = DBA_DATA_FRAME)
  dge_$peakID = as.numeric(rownames(dge_))
  dge_ <- merge(dge_, tlr7_ly6cmon_nearestGeneBodies, by = "peakID", all.x = TRUE, no.dups = FALSE)
  dge_ <- left_join(dge_, tlr7_ly6cmon_promoters, by = "peakID", keep = FALSE)
  dge_$peakPosition <- paste0(dge_$Chr, ":", dge_$Start, "-", dge_$End)
  dge_ <- dplyr::arrange(dge_, FDR) %>%
    dplyr::filter(Chr %in% filterChr)
  dge_tlr7_ly6cmon[[iContrast]] <- dge_
}
names(dge_tlr7_ly6cmon) <- tlr7_ly6cmon_contrasts$name
```

Export differential peaks
```{r export differential peaks}
for (contrast in names(dge_tlr7_ly6cmon)) {
  dge_ <- dge_tlr7_ly6cmon[[contrast]]
  out <- dge_ %>%
    dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::select(peakPosition, Fold, `p-value`, FDR, 
                  promoterSymbol, promoterENS, distanceToPromoter, 
                  closestGene, closestGeneENS, distanceToGene) %>%
    dplyr::rename(logFC = Fold)
  write.table(out, file = paste0("differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/TLR7IRF5ko-TLR7-Ly6CMon_differential_peaks_annotated.csv"), sep = ",", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
  bed <- dge_ %>%
    dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::select(Chr, Start, End)
  bed <- distinct(bed)
  bed$peakID <- 1:nrow(bed)
  bed$blank <- "1"
  bed$strand <- "+"
  write.table(dplyr::select(bed, peakID, Chr, Start, End, strand), file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/TLR7IRF5ko-TLR7-Ly6CMon_differential_peaks.txt", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  # Export minimal BED file of differential peaks for GREAT
  minimal_bed <- bed %>%
    dplyr::filter(Start >= 0, Chr %in% filterChr) %>%
    dplyr::select(Chr, Start, End)
  write.table(minimal_bed, file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/great_bed_files/TLR7IRF5ko-TLR7-Ly6CMon_differential_peaks.bed", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  # Export BED file for peaks that are significantly more accessible (i.e. upregulated)
  upregulated_bed <- dge_ %>%
    dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05 & Fold > 1) %>%
    dplyr::select(Chr, Start, End)
  write.table(upregulated_bed, file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/homer_bed_files/TLR7IRF5ko-TLR7-Ly6CMon_upregulated_peaks.bed", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  # Export BED file for peaks that are significantly less accessible (i.e. downregulated)
  downregulated_bed <- dge_ %>%
    dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05 & Fold < -1) %>%
    dplyr::select(Chr, Start, End)
  write.table(downregulated_bed, file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/homer_bed_files/TLR7IRF5ko-TLR7-Ly6CMon_downregulated_peaks.bed", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
}
```

Categorize hits and make volcano plot annotated with nearest genes
```{r nearest gene volcano plot}
dge_tlr7_ly6cmon_reg <- dge_tlr7_ly6cmon[[1]] %>%
  mutate(regulation = case_when(
    Fold > 1 & `FDR`< 0.05 ~ "up",
    Fold < -1 & `FDR`< 0.05 ~ "down",

  ))

#pdf(file = "plots/exclude_irf5_tlr7/TLR7IRF5ko-TLR7-Ly6CMon_genes_volcano.pdf", width = 8, height = 8)
ggplot(data = dge_tlr7_ly6cmon_reg, aes(x = Fold, y = -log10(`FDR`), color = regulation)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.7, size=2.5, shape = 19) +
  geom_text_repel(data = . %>%
    mutate(label = ifelse(peakID %in% tlr7_ly6cmon_top_hits$peakID, closestGene, "")),
    aes(label = label), color = "black", size = 3.5, segment.color = "black", segment.size = 0.4, box.padding = 0.75, force = 10, max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend = FALSE) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), color = "black", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), color = "black", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "TLR7.1 IRF5-/- vs. TLR7.1 monocytes", subtitle = "Peaks labeled by nearest gene", color = "", x = expression("log"[2]*"FC"), y = expression("-log"[10]*"FDR")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
#dev.off()
```

Correlate DARs with DEG data from RNAseq
```{r correlate DAR DEG data}
# Import RNAseq DEG data and filter to only significant DEGs (FDR/adjp < 0.05 and 2-fold change)
rnaseq_tlr7_ly6cmon <- read.csv("rnaseq_degs/DEgenes_Ly6ChiMono_TLR7.1_IRF5ko - Ly6ChiMono_TLR7.1.csv")
rnaseq_tlr7_ly6cmon_significant <- rnaseq_tlr7_ly6cmon #%>%
#  dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val <= 0.05) %>%
#  dplyr::filter(abs(log2FC) >= 1)
# Calculate maximum log2FC for DEGs with multiple log2FC
rnaseq_tlr7_ly6cmon_maxlog2FC <- rnaseq_tlr7_ly6cmon_significant %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarize(max_rnaseq_log2FC = max(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE))
# Retain only significant DARs in DAR dataframe (FDR/adjp < 0.05)
atac_tlr7_ly6cmon_significant <- dge_tlr7_ly6cmon_reg %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR <= 0.05)
# Calculate average log2FC for genes near multiple DARs and set FC cutoff to 2
atac_tlr7_ly6cmon_meanlog2FC <- atac_tlr7_ly6cmon_significant %>%
  group_by(closestGene) %>%
  summarize(mean_atac_log2FC = mean(Fold, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(closestGene)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(gene = closestGene) %>%
  dplyr::filter(abs(mean_atac_log2FC) >= 1)
# Merge DEG and DAR log2FC dataframes and categorize based on quadrant
merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ly6cmon <- left_join(rnaseq_tlr7_ly6cmon_maxlog2FC, atac_tlr7_ly6cmon_meanlog2FC, by = "gene")
merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ly6cmon$quadrant <- ifelse(merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ly6cmon$mean_atac_log2FC > 0 & merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ly6cmon$max_rnaseq_log2FC > 0, "I", 
                                                        ifelse(merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ly6cmon$mean_atac_log2FC <= 0 & merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ly6cmon$max_rnaseq_log2FC > 0, "II", 
                                                               ifelse(merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ly6cmon$mean_atac_log2FC <= 0 & merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ly6cmon$max_rnaseq_log2FC <= 0, "III",
                                                                      "IV")))
# Plot DEG vs. DAR log2FC
ggplot(data = merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ly6cmon, aes(x = mean_atac_log2FC, y = max_rnaseq_log2FC, color = quadrant)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "TLR7+IRF5ko vs. TLR7+ Ly6CHI monocytes", color = "", x = expression("ATAC-seq log"[2]*"FC"), y = expression("RNAseq log"[2]*"FC")) +
  theme_classic()
```

##### Generate TF correlation matrix

Import full collection of mouse TF PWMs from HOCOMOCO
```{r import TF PWMs}
# Load MEME file downloaded from HOCOMOCO
tf_motifs <- read_meme("HOCOMOCOv11_full_MOUSE_mono_meme_format.meme")
# Convert to PFMatrixList for use with motifmatchr
pfm_list_prep <- lapply(tf_motifs, function(m) {
  new("PFMatrix",
      ID = m@name,
      name = m@name,
      matrixClass = "PFM",
      strand = "+",
      tags = list(),
      profileMatrix = m@motif)
})
pfm_list <- PFMatrixList(pfm_list_prep)
```

Prepare counts RangedSummarizedExperiment object as input for chromVAR
```{r prepare counts matrix}
# Get raw counts matrix from dba.count()
raw_counts_dba_tlr7_ly6cmon <- dba(sampleSheet = tlr7_ly6cmon_samples)
raw_counts_dba_tlr7_ly6cmon <- dba.count(raw_counts_dba_tlr7_ly6cmon, summits = TRUE)
raw_counts_dba_tlr7_ly6cmon <- dba.count(raw_counts_dba_tlr7_ly6cmon, peaks = NULL, score = DBA_SCORE_READS)
raw_counts_matrix_tlr7_ly6cmon <- dba.peakset(raw_counts_dba_tlr7_ly6cmon, bRetrieve = TRUE, DataType = DBA_DATA_FRAME)
# Get peak GRanges and raw counts objects
peaks_granges_tlr7_ly6cmon <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(raw_counts_matrix_tlr7_ly6cmon[, 1:3])
raw_counts_data_tlr7_ly6cmon <- raw_counts_matrix_tlr7_ly6cmon[, 4:ncol(raw_counts_matrix_tlr7_ly6cmon)]
# Create RangedSummarizedExperiment object as input for chromVAR and add depth column to sample metadata
se_object_tlr7_ly6cmon <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assays = list(counts = as.matrix(raw_counts_data_tlr7_ly6cmon)),
  rowRanges = peaks_granges_tlr7_ly6cmon
)
total_depth_tlr7_ly6cmon <- colSums(assay(se_object_tlr7_ly6cmon, "counts"))
colData(se_object_tlr7_ly6cmon)$depth <- total_depth_tlr7_ly6cmon
# Add GC bias for determining background peaks
se_object_gc_tlr7_ly6cmon <- addGCBias(se_object_tlr7_ly6cmon, genome = BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm39)
```

#### TLR7+ vs. WT Ly6CHI monocytes

```{r TLR7+ vs WT Ly6CHI mon consensus peaks}
# Edit sample sheet to include only TLR7+ and WT samples and remove CD45-1 allele from treatment column
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_samples <- ly6cmon_samples %>%
  mutate(Treatment = gsub("-CD45-1", "", Treatment)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Treatment == "TLR7" | Treatment == "B6")
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_dba <- dba(sampleSheet=wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_samples)
# Generate consensus peakset
wt_tlr7_consensus_peakset <- dba.peakset(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_dba, consensus = TRUE, minOverlap = 2)
# Filter consensus peakset to exclude peaks <50bp or >10000bp
wt_tlr7_filtered_consensus_peakset <- dba.peakset(wt_tlr7_consensus_peakset, bRetrieve = TRUE) #Number of peaks before filtering: 51755
wt_tlr7_filtered_consensus_peakset <- wt_tlr7_filtered_consensus_peakset[width(wt_tlr7_filtered_consensus_peakset) >= 50 & width(wt_tlr7_filtered_consensus_peakset) <= 10000] #Number of peaks after filtering: 51712
# Make count matrix using filtered peaks
consensus_peaks_wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_counts <- dba.count(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_dba, peaks = wt_tlr7_filtered_consensus_peakset, summits = TRUE)
#Old code for calculating consensus peaks w/o filtering: consensus_peaks_wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_counts <- dba.count(consensus_peaks_wt_tlr7_ly6cmon, summits = TRUE)
dba.plotPCA(consensus_peaks_wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_counts, DBA_TREATMENT)
```

Get consensus peak set and annotate peaks to promoters and gene bodies
```{r annotate peaks}
# Prepare peaks for annotation
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist <- dba.peakset(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_model_norm, bRetrieve = T, DataType = DBA_DATA_FRAME)
filterChr <- c("chr1", "chr2", "chr3", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5", "chr6", "chr7", "chr8", "chr9", "chr10", "chr11", "chr12", "chr13", "chr14", "chr15", "chr16", "chr17", "chr18", "chr19", "chrX", "chrY")
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peak_bed <- wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist %>%
  dplyr::filter(START >= 0, CHR %in% filterChr) %>%
  dplyr::select(CHR, START, END)
write.table(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peak_bed, file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/great_bed_files/TLR7-WT-Ly6CMon_consensus_peaks.bed", quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE) # Export consensus peaks BED as background for GREAT
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist$peakID <- 1:nrow(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist)
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g <- GRanges(seqnames = wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist$CHR, 
                                   IRanges(start = wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist$START, 
                                           end = wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist$END), 
                                   strand = "*", 
                                   peakID = wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist$peakID)
seqlevelsStyle(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g) <- "UCSC"
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g <- wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g[seqnames(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g) %in% paste0("chr", c(1:23, "X", "Y"))]
seqlevels(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g) <- ucsc_levels
seqlevelsStyle(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g) <- "NCBI"
seqlevels(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g)

# Annotate closest gene bodies
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g <- ChIPpeakAnno::annotatePeakInBatch(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g,
                                                               AnnotationData = annoData,
                                                               output = "nearestLocation",
                                                               select = "first")
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g <- ChIPpeakAnno::addGeneIDs(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g, orgAnn = "org.Mm.eg.db", IDs2Add = c("symbol"))
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_nearestGeneBodies <- data.frame(peakID = wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g$peakID, 
                                             closestGene = wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g$symbol, 
                                             distanceToGene = wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g$distancetoFeature, 
                                             closestGeneENS = wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g$feature)

# Now, all promoters within +/- 10 000 bp (one to many)
seqlevelsStyle(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g) <- "UCSC"
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g <- ChIPpeakAnno::annotatePeakInBatch(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g, 
                                                                  AnnotationData = annoData, 
                                                                  output = "nearestBiDirectionalPromoters",
                                                                  bindingRegion = c(-10000, 10000),
                                                                  select = "all")
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g <- ChIPpeakAnno::addGeneIDs(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g, orgAnn = "org.Mm.eg.db", IDs2Add = c("symbol"))
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_nearPromoters <- data.frame(peakID = wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g$peakID,
                                         distanceToPromoter = wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g$distanceToSite,
                                         promoterSymbol = wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g$gene_name,
                                         promoterENS = wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g$feature)

# All peaks that weren't annotated, we are now going to find, and then look for the one closest promoter within 100 000 bp (one to one)
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_missingPeakIDs <- setdiff(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g$peakID, wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g$peakID)
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_missingPeaks.g <- wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g[wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peaklist.g$peakID %in% wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_missingPeakIDs]
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_farPromoters.g <- ChIPpeakAnno::annotatePeakInBatch(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_missingPeaks.g,
                                                                 AnnotationData = annoData,
                                                                 output = "nearestBiDirectionalPromoters", 
                                                                 bindingRegion = c(-100000, 100000),
                                                                 select = "all")
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_farPromoters <- data.frame(peakID = wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_farPromoters.g$peakID,
                                        distanceToPromoter = wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_farPromoters.g$distanceToSite,
                                        promoterSymbol = wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_farPromoters.g$gene_name,
                                        promoterENS = wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_farPromoters.g$feature)
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_promoters <- rbind(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_nearPromoters, wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_farPromoters)
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_promoters <- dplyr::distinct(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_promoters)
```

Process contrasts
```{r process contrasts}
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_contrasts <- dba.show(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_model_norm, bContrast = TRUE)
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_contrasts <- dplyr::mutate(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_contrasts, name = paste0(Group, "_vs_", Group2))
dge_wt_tlr7_ly6cmon <- c()
for (iContrast in 1:nrow(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_contrasts)) {
  dge_ <- dba.report(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_model_norm, method = DBA_DESEQ2, contrast = iContrast, th = 1, DataType = DBA_DATA_FRAME)
  dge_$peakID = as.numeric(rownames(dge_))
  dge_ <- merge(dge_, wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_nearestGeneBodies, by = "peakID", all.x = TRUE, no.dups = FALSE)
  dge_ <- left_join(dge_, wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_promoters, by = "peakID", keep = FALSE)
  dge_$peakPosition <- paste0(dge_$Chr, ":", dge_$Start, "-", dge_$End)
  dge_ <- dplyr::arrange(dge_, FDR) %>%
    dplyr::filter(Chr %in% filterChr)
  dge_wt_tlr7_ly6cmon[[iContrast]] <- dge_
}
names(dge_wt_tlr7_ly6cmon) <- wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_contrasts$name
```

Export differential peaks
```{r export differential peaks}
for (contrast in names(dge_wt_tlr7_ly6cmon)) {
  dge_ <- dge_wt_tlr7_ly6cmon[[contrast]]
  out <- dge_ %>%
    dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::select(peakPosition, Fold, `p-value`, FDR, 
                  promoterSymbol, promoterENS, distanceToPromoter, 
                  closestGene, closestGeneENS, distanceToGene) %>%
    dplyr::rename(logFC = Fold)
  write.table(out, file = paste0("differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/TLR7-WT-Ly6CMon_differential_peaks_annotated.csv"), sep = ",", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
  bed <- dge_ %>%
    dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::select(Chr, Start, End)
  bed <- distinct(bed)
  bed$peakID <- 1:nrow(bed)
  bed$blank <- "1"
  bed$strand <- "+"
  write.table(dplyr::select(bed, peakID, Chr, Start, End, strand), file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/TLR7-WT-Ly6CMon_differential_peaks.txt", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  write.table(dplyr::select(bed, Chr, Start, End, strand), file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/TLR7-WT-Ly6CMon_differential_peaks_for_liftover.txt", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  # Export minimal BED file of differential peaks for GREAT
  minimal_bed <- bed %>%
    dplyr::filter(Start >= 0, Chr %in% filterChr) %>%
    dplyr::select(Chr, Start, End)
  write.table(minimal_bed, file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/great_bed_files/TLR7-WT-Ly6CMon_differential_peaks.bed", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  # Export BED file for peaks that are significantly more accessible (i.e. upregulated)
  upregulated_bed <- dge_ %>%
    dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05 & Fold > 1) %>%
    dplyr::select(Chr, Start, End)
  write.table(upregulated_bed, file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/homer_bed_files/TLR7-WT-Ly6CMon_upregulated_peaks.bed", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  # Export BED file for peaks that are significantly less accessible (i.e. downregulated)
  downregulated_bed <- dge_ %>%
    dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05 & Fold < -1) %>%
    dplyr::select(Chr, Start, End)
  write.table(downregulated_bed, file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/homer_bed_files/TLR7-WT-Ly6CMon_downregulated_peaks.bed", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
}
```

Count number of reads overlapping differential peaks
```{r count number of reads per differential peak}
# Load BED of differential peaks
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_diffPeaks <- import("differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/great_bed_files/TLR7-WT-Ly6CMon_differential_peaks.bed")
# Initialize dataframe to store read counts per peak
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peak_names <- paste0(seqnames(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_diffPeaks), ":", start(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_diffPeaks), "-", end(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_diffPeaks))
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peak_readCounts <- data.frame(Peak = wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peak_names)
# Count reads overlapping each peak from sample BAM files
for (i in seq_len(nrow(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_samples))) {
  bam_file <- wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_samples$bamReads[i]
  sample_name <- wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_samples$SampleID[i]
  gal <- readGAlignments(bam_file)
  reads_gr <- granges(gal)
  counts <- countOverlaps(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_diffPeaks, reads_gr)
  wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peak_readCounts[[sample_name]] <- counts
}
wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peak_readCounts$TotalReadsinPeak <- rowSums(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peak_readCounts[sapply(wt_tlr7_ly6cmon_peak_readCounts, is.numeric)], na.rm = TRUE)

#dev.off()
```

## Perform differential binding analysis on TLR7+ iHPCs vs. TLR7+ Ly6CHI monocytes

```{r TLR7+ iHPC Ly6CHI mon consensus peaks}
# Edit sample sheet to include only TLR7+ iHPCs and Ly6CHI monocytes and remove CD45-1 allele from treatment column
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_samples <- samples %>%
  mutate(Treatment = gsub("-CD45-1", "", Treatment)) %>%
  mutate(Factor = gsub("-CD45-1", "", Factor)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Factor == "TLR7_TLR7") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Tissue == "iHPC" | Tissue == "Ly6CMon")
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_dba <- dba(sampleSheet=tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_samples)
# Generate consensus peakset
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_cons_by_cond <- dba.peakset(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_dba, consensus=DBA_CONDITION, minOverlap=2)
# Retrieve the union of the two condition-level consensuses
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_consensus_union <- dba.peakset(
  tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_cons_by_cond, bRetrieve=TRUE,
  peaks=tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_cons_by_cond$masks$Consensus,
  minOverlap=1
)
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_consensus_union <- tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_consensus_union[width(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_consensus_union) >= 50 & width(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_consensus_union) <= 10000]
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_dba <- dba.count(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_dba, peaks = tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_consensus_union, summits = 250, bUseSummarizeOverlaps=FALSE)
```

Get consensus peak set and annotate peaks to promoters and gene bodies
```{r annotate peaks}
# Prepare peaks for annotation
#tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist <- dba.peakset(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_model_norm, bRetrieve = T, DataType = DBA_DATA_FRAME)
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist <- dba.peakset(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_dba, bRetrieve = T, DataType = DBA_DATA_FRAME)
filterChr <- c("chr1", "chr2", "chr3", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5", "chr6", "chr7", "chr8", "chr9", "chr10", "chr11", "chr12", "chr13", "chr14", "chr15", "chr16", "chr17", "chr18", "chr19", "chrX", "chrY")
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peak_bed <- tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist %>%
  dplyr::filter(START >= 0, CHR %in% filterChr) %>%
  dplyr::select(CHR, START, END)
write.table(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peak_bed, file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/great_bed_files/TLR7-iHPC-Ly6CMon_consensus_peaks.bed", quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE) # Export consensus peaks BED as background for GREAT
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist$peakID <- 1:nrow(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist)
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist.g <- GRanges(seqnames = tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist$CHR, 
                           IRanges(start = tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist$START, 
                                   end = tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist$END), 
                           strand = "*", 
                           peakID = tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist$peakID)
seqlevelsStyle(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist.g) <- "UCSC"
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist.g <- tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist.g[seqnames(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist.g) %in% paste0("chr", c(1:23, "X", "Y"))]
seqlevels(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist.g) <- ucsc_levels
seqlevelsStyle(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist.g) <- "NCBI"
seqlevels(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist.g)

# Annotate closest gene bodies
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g <- ChIPpeakAnno::annotatePeakInBatch(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist.g,
                                                               AnnotationData = annoData,
                                                               output = "nearestLocation",
                                                               select = "first")
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g <- ChIPpeakAnno::addGeneIDs(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g, orgAnn = "org.Mm.eg.db", IDs2Add = c("symbol"))
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_nearestGeneBodies <- data.frame(peakID = tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g$peakID, 
                                             closestGene = tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g$symbol, 
                                             distanceToGene = tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g$distancetoFeature, 
                                             closestGeneENS = tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_geneBodies.g$feature)

# Now, all promoters within +/- 10 000 bp (one to many)
seqlevelsStyle(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist.g) <- "UCSC"
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g <- ChIPpeakAnno::annotatePeakInBatch(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist.g, 
                                                                 AnnotationData = annoData, 
                                                                 output = "nearestBiDirectionalPromoters",
                                                                 bindingRegion = c(-10000, 10000),
                                                                 select = "all")
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g <- ChIPpeakAnno::addGeneIDs(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g, orgAnn = "org.Mm.eg.db", IDs2Add = c("symbol"))
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_nearPromoters <- data.frame(peakID = tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g$peakID,
                                         distanceToPromoter = tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g$distanceToSite,
                                         promoterSymbol = tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g$gene_name,
                                         promoterENS = tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g$feature)

# All peaks that weren't annotated, we are now going to find, and then look for the one closest promoter within 100 000 bp (one to one)
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_missingPeakIDs <- setdiff(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist.g$peakID, tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_nearPromoters.g$peakID)
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_missingPeaks.g <- tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist.g[tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_peaklist.g$peakID %in% tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_missingPeakIDs]
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_farPromoters.g <- ChIPpeakAnno::annotatePeakInBatch(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_missingPeaks.g,
                                                                 AnnotationData = annoData,
                                                                 output = "nearestBiDirectionalPromoters", 
                                                                 bindingRegion = c(-100000, 100000),
                                                                 select = "all")
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_farPromoters <- data.frame(peakID = tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_farPromoters.g$peakID,
                                        distanceToPromoter = tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_farPromoters.g$distanceToSite,
                                        promoterSymbol = tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_farPromoters.g$gene_name,
                                        promoterENS = tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_farPromoters.g$feature)
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_promoters <- rbind(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_nearPromoters, tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_farPromoters)
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_promoters <- dplyr::distinct(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_promoters)
```

Process contrasts
```{r process contrasts}
#tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_contrasts <- dba.show(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_model_norm, bContrast = TRUE)
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_contrasts <- dba.show(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_dba, bContrast = TRUE)
tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_contrasts <- dplyr::mutate(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_contrasts, name = paste0(Group, "_vs_", Group2))
dge_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon <- c()
for (iContrast in 1:nrow(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_contrasts)) {
#  dge_ <- dba.report(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_model_norm, method = DBA_DESEQ2, contrast = iContrast, th = 1, DataType = DBA_DATA_FRAME)
  dge_ <- dba.report(tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_dba, method = DBA_EDGER, contrast = iContrast, th = 1, DataType = DBA_DATA_FRAME)
  dge_$peakID = as.numeric(rownames(dge_))
  dge_ <- merge(dge_, tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_nearestGeneBodies, by = "peakID", all.x = TRUE, no.dups = FALSE)
  dge_ <- left_join(dge_, tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_promoters, by = "peakID", keep = FALSE)
  dge_$peakPosition <- paste0(dge_$Chr, ":", dge_$Start, "-", dge_$End)
  dge_ <- dplyr::arrange(dge_, FDR) %>%
    dplyr::filter(Chr %in% filterChr)
  dge_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon[[iContrast]] <- dge_
}
names(dge_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon) <- tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_contrasts$name
```

Export differential peaks
```{r export differential peaks}
options(scipen = 999) # Turn off scientific notation
for (contrast in names(dge_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon)) {
  dge_ <- dge_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon[[contrast]]
  out <- dge_ %>%
    dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::select(peakPosition, Fold, `p-value`, FDR, 
                  promoterSymbol, promoterENS, distanceToPromoter, 
                  closestGene, closestGeneENS, distanceToGene) %>%
    dplyr::rename(logFC = Fold)
  write.table(out, file = paste0("differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/TLR7-iHPC-Ly6CMon_differential_peaks_annotated.csv"), sep = ",", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
  bed <- dge_ %>%
    dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::select(Chr, Start, End)
  bed <- distinct(bed)
  bed$peakID <- 1:nrow(bed)
  bed$blank <- "1"
  bed$strand <- "+"
  bed$Start <- as.numeric(bed$Start)
  bed$End <- as.numeric(bed$End)
  write.table(dplyr::select(bed, peakID, Chr, Start, End, strand), file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/TLR7-iHPC-Ly6CMon_differential_peaks.txt", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  write.table(dplyr::select(bed, Chr, Start, End, strand), file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/TLR7-iHPC-Ly6CMon_differential_peaks_for_liftover.txt", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  # Export minimal BED file of differential peaks for GREAT
  minimal_bed <- bed %>%
    dplyr::filter(Start >= 0, Chr %in% filterChr) %>%
    dplyr::select(Chr, Start, End)
  write.table(minimal_bed, file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/great_bed_files/TLR7-iHPC-Ly6CMon_differential_peaks.bed", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  # Export BED file for peaks that are significantly more accessible (i.e. upregulated)
  upregulated_bed <- dge_ %>%
    dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05 & Fold > 1) %>%
    dplyr::select(Chr, Start, End)
  write.table(upregulated_bed, file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/homer_bed_files/TLR7-iHPC-Ly6CMon_upregulated_peaks.bed", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  # Export BED file for peaks that are significantly less accessible (i.e. downregulated)
  downregulated_bed <- dge_ %>%
    dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05 & Fold < -1) %>%
    dplyr::select(Chr, Start, End)
  write.table(downregulated_bed, file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/homer_bed_files/TLR7-iHPC-Ly6CMon_downregulated_peaks.bed", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
}
```

Categorize hits and make volcano plot annotated with nearest genes
```{r nearest gene volcano plot}
dge_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_reg <- dge_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon[[1]] %>%
  mutate(regulation = case_when(
    Fold > 1 & `FDR`< 0.05 ~ "up",
    Fold < -1 & `FDR`< 0.05 ~ "down",
    TRUE ~ "unaffected"
  ))

#pdf(file = "plots/exclude_irf5_tlr7/TLR7-iHPC-Ly6CMon_genes_volcano.pdf", width = 8, height = 8)
ggplot(data = dge_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_reg, aes(x = Fold, y = -log10(`FDR`), color = regulation)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.7, size=2.5, shape = 19) +
  geom_text_repel(data = . %>%
    mutate(label = ifelse(peakID %in% tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_top_hits$peakID, closestGene, "")),
    aes(label = label), color = "black", size = 3.5, segment.color = "black", segment.size = 0.4, box.padding = 0.75, force = 8, max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#2166AC", "#E6E6E6", "#B2182B"),
                     labels = c("More accessible in TLR7.1 monocytes", "Not significant", "More accessible in TLR7.1 iHPCs")) +
#  ylim(0, 40) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), color = "black", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), color = "black", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "TLR7.1 iHPCs vs. TLR7.1 monocytes", subtitle = "Peaks labeled by nearest gene", color = "", x = expression("log"[2]*"FC"), y = expression("-log"[10]*"FDR")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
#dev.off()
```

Test code for PCA plot formatting to send to Susana
```{r}
df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = runif(10),
  PC2 = runif(10)
)
df$Group <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 3, 4, 2, 1, 1, 3)

blue = rgb(45, 173, 216, maxColorValue=255)
magenta = rgb(216, 23, 126, maxColorValue=255)
purple = rgb(47, 41, 106, maxColorValue=255)
green = rgb(0, 153, 73, maxColorValue=255)

group_colors <-c(blue, magenta, purple, green)

library(lattice)


xyplot(
  PC2 ~ PC1,
  data = df,
  groups = Group,

  auto.key = list(
    space = "right",
    points = TRUE,
    lines = FALSE,
    cex = 1
  ),

  pch = 16,
  cex = 1.2,
  col = group_colors,

  par.settings = list(
    superpose.symbol = list(
      pch = 16,
      col = group_colors,
      cex = 1.2
    )
  ),

  xlab = "Principal Component #1 [63%]",
  ylab = "Principal Component #2 [15%]",
  main = "PCA: Treatment",

  aspect = 1
)
```

Correlate DARs with DEG data from RNAseq
```{r correlate DAR DEG data}
# Import RNAseq DEG data and filter to only significant DEGs (FDR/adjp < 0.05 and 2-fold change)
rnaseq_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon <- read.csv("rnaseq_degs/spleen_DEgenes_iHPC_TLR7.1 - Ly6ChiMono_TLR7.1_TTchimeras_changedCategNames (1).csv")
rnaseq_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_significant <- rnaseq_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon %>%
  dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val <= 0.05) #%>%
#  dplyr::filter(abs(log2FC) >= 1)
colnames(rnaseq_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_significant)[colnames(rnaseq_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_significant) == "log2FC"] <- "rnaseq_log2FC"
# Determine DEGs that have multiple log2FC
rnaseq_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_significant$gene[duplicated(rnaseq_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_significant$gene)] # None
# Calculate maximum log2FC for DEGs with multiple log2FC (not needed based on checking duplicates)
#rnaseq_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_maxlog2FC <- rnaseq_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_significant %>%
#  group_by(gene) %>%
#  summarize(max_rnaseq_log2FC = max(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE))
# Retain only significant DARs in DAR dataframe (FDR/adjp < 0.05)
atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_significant <- dge_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_reg %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR <= 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(closestGene)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Start = as.integer(Start)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(End = as.integer(End)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(gene = closestGene) %>%
  dplyr::rename(atac_log2FC = Fold)
# Calculate average log2FC for genes near multiple DARs and set FC cutoff to 2
#atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_meanlog2FC <- atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_significant %>%
#  group_by(closestGene) %>%
#  summarize(mean_atac_log2FC = mean(Fold, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
#  dplyr::filter(!is.na(closestGene)) %>%
#  dplyr::rename(gene = closestGene) %>%
#  dplyr::filter(abs(mean_atac_log2FC) >= 1)
# Merge DEG and DAR log2FC dataframes and categorize based on quadrant
#merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon <- left_join(rnaseq_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_maxlog2FC, #atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_meanlog2FC, by = "gene")
# Merge DEG and DAR dataframes without log2FC filters and categorize based on quadrant
merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon <- left_join(rnaseq_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_significant, atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_significant, by = "gene")
merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_noPromoters <- merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon %>%
  dplyr::select(-distanceToPromoter, -promoterSymbol, -promoterENS) %>%
  distinct()
merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_noPromoters$quadrant <- ifelse(merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_noPromoters$atac_log2FC >= 1 & merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_noPromoters$rnaseq_log2FC >= 1, "I", 
  ifelse(merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_noPromoters$atac_log2FC <= -1 & merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_noPromoters$rnaseq_log2FC >= 1, "II", 
    ifelse(merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_noPromoters$atac_log2FC <= -1 & merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_noPromoters$rnaseq_log2FC <= -1, "III",
      ifelse(merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_noPromoters$atac_log2FC >= 1 & merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_noPromoters$rnaseq_log2FC <= -1,"IV", "non-significant"))))
merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_noPromoters$quadrant <- factor(merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_noPromoters$quadrant, levels = c("I", "II", "III", "IV", "non-significant"))
# Plot DEG vs. DAR log2FC
pdf(file = "plots/exclude_irf5_tlr7/TLR7-iHPC-Ly6CMon_RNAseq_ATAC_correlation.pdf", width = 8, height = 8)
ggplot(data = merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_noPromoters, aes(x = atac_log2FC, y = rnaseq_log2FC, color = quadrant)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#7CAE00", "#F8766D", "#00BFC4", "#C77CFF", "#E6E6E6")) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.5, se = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  stat_cor(aes(group = 1, label = paste(after_stat(rr.label), after_stat(p.label), sep = "~`,`~")), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray", linetype = "dotted") +
  labs(title = "TLR7+ iHPCs vs. Ly6CHI monocytes", color = "", x = expression("ATAC-seq log"[2]*"FC"), y = expression("RNAseq log"[2]*"FC")) +
  theme_bw()
dev.off()
# Export data for DEG vs. DAR plot
write.csv(merged_rnaseq_atac_tlr7_ihpc_ly6cmon_noPromoters, "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/TLR7-iHPC-Ly6CMon_DEG_DAR_correlation.csv", row.names = FALSE)
# Export peak data for quadrants I (up in both RNAseq/ATAC) and III (down in both RNAseq/ATAC) for HOMER
```

## pMon

#### TLR7+ vs. TLR7+IRF5ko patrolling monocytes

```{r patrolling mon consensus peaks}
# Edit sample sheet to include only pMons and remove CD45-1 allele from treatment column, generate DBA object
pmon_samples <- samples %>%
  mutate(Treatment = gsub("-CD45-1", "", Treatment)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Tissue == "pMon")
pmon_dba <- dba(sampleSheet=pmon_samples)
# Generate consensus peakset
pmon_consensus_peakset <- dba.peakset(pmon_dba, consensus = TRUE, minOverlap = 2)
# Filter consensus peakset to exclude peaks <50bp or >10000bp
pmon_filtered_consensus_peakset <- dba.peakset(pmon_consensus_peakset, bRetrieve = TRUE) #Number of peaks before filtering: 39464
pmon_filtered_consensus_peakset <- pmon_filtered_consensus_peakset[width(pmon_filtered_consensus_peakset) >= 50 & width(pmon_filtered_consensus_peakset) <= 10000] #Number of peaks after filtering: 39434
# Make count matrix using filtered peaks
consensus_peaks_pmon_counts <- dba.count(pmon_dba, peaks = pmon_filtered_consensus_peakset, summits = TRUE)
dba.plotPCA(consensus_peaks_pmon_counts, DBA_TREATMENT)
```

Make MA plot of non-normalized data (using total aligned reads in BAM files)
```{r MA plot}
dba.plotMA(consensus_peaks_pmon_counts, bNormalized = FALSE, sub = "Non-Normalized",
           contrast = list(`TLR7-IRF5ko` = consensus_peaks_pmon_counts$masks$`TLR7-IRF5ko`,
                           TLR7 = consensus_peaks_pmon_counts$masks$TLR7))
```

Establish contrasts to be tested against the model
```{r establish contrasts}
pmon_model <- dba.contrast(consensus_peaks_pmon_counts, categories = DBA_TREATMENT, block = c(DBA_REPLICATE, DBA_CONDITION), reorderMeta = list(Treatment = "TLR7"))
pmon_model
```

Normalize dataset
```{r normalize}
pmon_model_norm <- dba.normalize(pmon_model, method = DBA_DESEQ2, library = DBA_LIBSIZE_FULL, normalize = DBA_NORM_LIB, background = FALSE)
pmon_model_norm
```

Make MA plot of normalized data
```{r MA plot}
dba.plotMA(consensus_peaks_pmon_counts, bNormalized = TRUE, sub = "Normalized (Default)",
           contrast = list(`TLR7-IRF5ko` = consensus_peaks_pmon_counts$masks$`TLR7-IRF5ko`,
                           TLR7 = consensus_peaks_pmon_counts$masks$TLR7))
```

Fit model and apply tests for the contrast
```{r fitting and testing}
pmon_model_norm <- dba.analyze(pmon_model_norm)
dba.show(pmon_model_norm, bContrasts = TRUE)
```

Make volcano plot with differential binding sites
```{r differential site volcano plot}
dba.plotVolcano(pmon_model_norm)
```

Make heatmap based on differential binding sites
```{r differential site heatmap}
plot(pmon_model_norm, contrast = 1)
```

Get consensus peak set and annotate peaks to promoters and gene bodies
```{r annotate peaks}
# Prepare peaks for annotation
pmon_peaklist <- dba.peakset(pmon_model_norm, bRetrieve = T, DataType = DBA_DATA_FRAME)
filterChr <- c("chr1", "chr2", "chr3", "chr3", "chr4", "chr5", "chr6", "chr7", "chr8", "chr9", "chr10", "chr11", "chr12", "chr13", "chr14", "chr15", "chr16", "chr17", "chr18", "chr19", "chrX", "chrY")
pmon_peak_bed <- pmon_peaklist %>%
  dplyr::filter(START >= 0, CHR %in% filterChr) %>%
  dplyr::select(CHR, START, END)
write.table(pmon_peak_bed, file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/great_bed_files/TLR7IRF5ko-TLR7-pMon_consensus_peaks.bed", quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE) # Export consensus peaks BED as background for GREAT
pmon_peaklist$peakID <- 1:nrow(pmon_peaklist)
pmon_peaklist.g <- GRanges(seqnames = pmon_peaklist$CHR, 
                                   IRanges(start = pmon_peaklist$START, 
                                           end = pmon_peaklist$END), 
                                   strand = "*", 
                                   peakID = pmon_peaklist$peakID)
seqlevelsStyle(pmon_peaklist.g) <- "UCSC"
pmon_peaklist.g <- pmon_peaklist.g[seqnames(pmon_peaklist.g) %in% paste0("chr", c(1:23, "X", "Y"))]
seqlevels(pmon_peaklist.g) <- ucsc_levels
seqlevelsStyle(pmon_peaklist.g) <- "NCBI"
seqlevels(pmon_peaklist.g)

# Annotate closest gene bodies
pmon_geneBodies.g <- ChIPpeakAnno::annotatePeakInBatch(pmon_peaklist.g,
                                                               AnnotationData = annoData,
                                                               output = "nearestLocation",
                                                               select = "first")
pmon_geneBodies.g <- ChIPpeakAnno::addGeneIDs(pmon_geneBodies.g, orgAnn = "org.Mm.eg.db", IDs2Add = c("symbol"))
pmon_nearestGeneBodies <- data.frame(peakID = pmon_geneBodies.g$peakID, 
                                             closestGene = pmon_geneBodies.g$symbol, 
                                             distanceToGene = pmon_geneBodies.g$distancetoFeature, 
                                             closestGeneENS = pmon_geneBodies.g$feature)

# Now, all promoters within +/- 10 000 bp (one to many)
seqlevelsStyle(pmon_peaklist.g) <- "UCSC"
pmon_nearPromoters.g <- ChIPpeakAnno::annotatePeakInBatch(pmon_peaklist.g, 
                                                                  AnnotationData = annoData, 
                                                                  output = "nearestBiDirectionalPromoters",
                                                                  bindingRegion = c(-10000, 10000),
                                                                  select = "all")
pmon_nearPromoters.g <- ChIPpeakAnno::addGeneIDs(pmon_nearPromoters.g, orgAnn = "org.Mm.eg.db", IDs2Add = c("symbol"))
pmon_nearPromoters <- data.frame(peakID = pmon_nearPromoters.g$peakID,
                                         distanceToPromoter = pmon_nearPromoters.g$distanceToSite,
                                         promoterSymbol = pmon_nearPromoters.g$gene_name,
                                         promoterENS = pmon_nearPromoters.g$feature)

# All peaks that weren't annotated, we are now going to find, and then look for the one closest promoter within 100 000 bp (one to one)
pmon_missingPeakIDs <- setdiff(pmon_peaklist.g$peakID, pmon_nearPromoters.g$peakID)
pmon_missingPeaks.g <- pmon_peaklist.g[pmon_peaklist.g$peakID %in% pmon_missingPeakIDs]
pmon_farPromoters.g <- ChIPpeakAnno::annotatePeakInBatch(pmon_missingPeaks.g,
                                                                 AnnotationData = annoData,
                                                                 output = "nearestBiDirectionalPromoters", 
                                                                 bindingRegion = c(-100000, 100000),
                                                                 select = "all")
pmon_farPromoters <- data.frame(peakID = pmon_farPromoters.g$peakID,
                                        distanceToPromoter = pmon_farPromoters.g$distanceToSite,
                                        promoterSymbol = pmon_farPromoters.g$gene_name,
                                        promoterENS = pmon_farPromoters.g$feature)
pmon_promoters <- rbind(pmon_nearPromoters, pmon_farPromoters)
pmon_promoters <- dplyr::distinct(pmon_promoters)
```

Process contrasts
```{r process contrasts}
pmon_contrasts <- dba.show(pmon_model_norm, bContrast = TRUE)
pmon_contrasts <- dplyr::mutate(pmon_contrasts, name = paste0(Group, "_vs_", Group2))
dge_pmon <- c()
for (iContrast in 1:nrow(pmon_contrasts)) {
  dge_ <- dba.report(pmon_model_norm, method = DBA_DESEQ2, contrast = iContrast, th = 1, DataType = DBA_DATA_FRAME)
  dge_$peakID = as.numeric(rownames(dge_))
  dge_ <- merge(dge_, pmon_nearestGeneBodies, by = "peakID", all.x = TRUE, no.dups = FALSE)
  dge_ <- left_join(dge_, pmon_promoters, by = "peakID", keep = FALSE)
  dge_$peakPosition <- paste0(dge_$Chr, ":", dge_$Start, "-", dge_$End)
  dge_ <- dplyr::arrange(dge_, FDR) %>%
    dplyr::filter(Chr %in% filterChr)
  dge_pmon[[iContrast]] <- dge_
}
names(dge_pmon) <- pmon_contrasts$name
```

Export differential peaks
```{r export differential peaks}
for (contrast in names(dge_pmon)) {
  dge_ <- dge_pmon[[contrast]]
  out <- dge_ %>%
    dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::select(peakPosition, Fold, `p-value`, FDR, 
                  promoterSymbol, promoterENS, distanceToPromoter, 
                  closestGene, closestGeneENS, distanceToGene) %>%
    dplyr::rename(logFC = Fold)
  write.table(out, file = paste0("differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/TLR7IRF5ko-TLR7-pMon_differential_peaks_annotated.csv"), sep = ",", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
  bed <- dge_ %>%
    dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::select(Chr, Start, End)
  bed <- distinct(bed)
  bed$peakID <- 1:nrow(bed)
  bed$blank <- "1"
  bed$strand <- "+"
  write.table(dplyr::select(bed, peakID, Chr, Start, End, strand), file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/TLR7IRF5ko-TLR7-pMon_differential_peaks.txt", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  write.table(dplyr::select(bed, Chr, Start, End, strand), file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/TLR7IRF5ko-TLR7-pMon_differential_peaks_for_liftover.txt", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  # Export minimal BED file of differential peaks for GREAT
  minimal_bed <- bed %>%
    dplyr::filter(Start >= 0, Chr %in% filterChr) %>%
    dplyr::select(Chr, Start, End)
  write.table(minimal_bed, file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/great_bed_files/TLR7IRF5ko-TLR7-pMon_differential_peaks.bed", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  # Export BED file for peaks that are significantly more accessible (i.e. upregulated)
  upregulated_bed <- dge_ %>%
    dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05 & Fold > 1) %>%
    dplyr::select(Chr, Start, End)
  write.table(upregulated_bed, file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/homer_bed_files/TLR7IRF5ko-TLR7-pMon_upregulated_peaks.bed", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  # Export BED file for peaks that are significantly less accessible (i.e. downregulated)
  downregulated_bed <- dge_ %>%
    dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05 & Fold < -1) %>%
    dplyr::select(Chr, Start, End)
  write.table(downregulated_bed, file = "differential_peaks/exclude_irf5_tlr7/homer_bed_files/TLR7IRF5ko-TLR7-pMon_downregulated_peaks.bed", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
}
```

Find top hits
```{r find top hits}
pmon_top_hits <- dge_pmon[[1]] %>%
  arrange(log10(FDR)) %>%
  group_by(sign(Fold)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15)
pmon_top_hits
```

Categorize hits and make volcano plot annotated with nearest genes
```{r nearest gene volcano plot}
dge_pmon_reg <- dge_pmon[[1]] %>%
  mutate(regulation = case_when(
    Fold > 1 & `FDR`< 0.05 ~ "up",
    Fold < -1 & `FDR`< 0.05 ~ "down",
    TRUE ~ "unaffected"
  ))

#pdf(file = "plots/exclude_irf5_tlr7/TLR7IRF5ko-TLR7-pMon_genes_volcano.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
ggplot(data = dge_pmon_reg, aes(x = Fold, y = -log10(`FDR`), color = regulation)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), color = "gray", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), color = "gray", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel(data = . %>%
                    mutate(label = ifelse(peakID %in% pmon_top_hits$peakID, closestGene, "")),
                  aes(label = label), box.padding = 0.75, force = 4, max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("firebrick1", "#E6E6E6", "dodgerblue1"),
                     labels = c("Less accessible", "Not significant", "More accessible")) +
  labs(title = "TLR7+IRF5ko vs. TLR7+ patrolling monocytes", subtitle = "Peaks labeled by nearest gene", color = "", x = expression("log"[2]*"FC"), y = expression("-log"[10]*"FDR")) +
  theme_classic()
#dev.off()
```
